exceptions.reason: The retired stylesheet package implicitly loaded preset artifacts. The compiler-owned stylesheet host now receives Manifest v1 explicitly and must not create hidden dependencies on generated preset files.
exceptions.old: Registering @import "@master/css" reports default-manifest.json and default-native.css as style dependencies.
exceptions.new: Registering the equivalent stylesheet with an explicit baseManifest reports neither generated preset artifact as a dependency.

exceptions.reason: The synchronous TypeScript MasterCSS facade was retired. The public @master/css surface now creates an asynchronous Rust-backed engine session and does not restore a compatibility shim.
exceptions.old: @master/css exposes MasterCSS.create({ manifest }) synchronously and returns the same manifest object with empty text.
exceptions.new: @master/css exposes createEngine({ manifest }) asynchronously, selects the native Rust binding, and returns an empty snapshot for an empty manifest.

exceptions.reason: Scanner extraction semantics now live in the owning Rust crate, while the TypeScript host keeps only private first-party framework adapters. Restoring the rc.87 third-party adapter registry would reintroduce a retired public semantic extension API and violate the Rust-only ownership boundary.
exceptions.old: Passing a custom .txt adapter before the built-in adapters extracts the adapter result block instead of the source text class hidden.
exceptions.new: The scanner options reject the retired adapters field and the Rust-backed built-in extraction pipeline observes hidden from the same .txt source.

exceptions.reason: The refactored CLI exposes generation as an explicit command and does not preserve the rc.87 root scanning command shape.
exceptions.old: Root help advertises source paths, watch, and no-export options directly on @master/css-cli.
exceptions.new: Root help advertises the master-css binary with explicit generate, lint, and inspect commands; generation options belong to generate.

exceptions.reason: The CLI refactor removes obsolete extract, render, and scan compatibility shims instead of retaining legacy command-specific errors.
exceptions.old: Invoking extract, render, or scan reports that the named command was removed.
exceptions.new: Invoking extract, render, or scan follows Commander's ordinary unknown-command failure path.

exceptions.reason: The published CLI has one deliberate binary name and does not restore the retired package-name binary representation.
exceptions.old: The package metadata represents the binary as the package-name string form expected by rc.87.
exceptions.new: The package metadata exposes only the master-css binary mapped to dist/bin/index.js.
